Hi Lina — thanks for sending these over. I reviewed the declaration pages quickly; before we proceed I need a few clarifications so we can queue the PO: 

Checklist (quick):
- COI: confirm the Additional Insured endorsement will name "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, and employees" (exact wording required).
- Endorsement: we need an "Additional Insured" endorsement on the commercial general liability policy and a waiver of subrogation on the workers' comp where applicable.
- Limits: confirm limits meet our procurement threshold (Commercial General Liability $1M/occurrence, $2M aggregate; Auto $1M).
- Subcontractors: disclose if you plan to engage subs for the pilot (we may need evidence of their coverage).

If the insurer needs 7-10 business days for the formal endorsement, we can consider a conditional PO to start a limited, non-production pilot provided all of the following are true:
- Pilot cap not to exceed $50k spend total
- StratusGrid provides declarations + broker confirmation email within 2 business days
- Written timeline for endorsement delivery (expected date)

I've attached our onboarding checklist for reference: redwood_onboarding_checklist_v2.pdf

Next steps: please confirm the three checklist items above and provide the broker contact if you want us to coordinate endorsement wording directly. Once we have that, Ben will evaluate the conditional PO path.

– Avery Johnson
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks Avery — quick responses inline and next steps below.

> COI: confirm the Additional Insured endorsement will name "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, and employees"
Our broker confirmed they can issue that endorsement but they will produce the formal endorsement (endorsement form) in 7-10 business days. I attached the policy declaration page for now (Insurance_Declaration_StratusGrid.pdf).

> Endorsement / waiver of subrogation
We can add Waiver of Subrogation on Workers' Comp for the pilot — broker said it is standard.

> Limits
Current limits meet the amounts you listed (1M/2M). See declaration page.

> Subcontractors
We do not plan to use subs for the pilot; if that changes we'll notify you.

Regarding a conditional PO: finance is amenable to a capped conditional PO for a 30-day pilot. We would prefer net-30 invoicing after milestone delivery.

Broker contact: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@brookfield-brokers.com>, +1 (415) 555-0192. He can expedite the endorsement if we coordinate wording directly.

Attachments: Insurance_Declaration_StratusGrid.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Lina
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Team — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. I reviewed the declaration pages and Lina's notes. Recommendation: proceed with a conditional PO for a 30-day pilot under these controls:

- PO cap $50,000 (non-production pilot)
- Procurement will open a conditional PO numbered PO-2026-0891 with explicit "conditional: endorsement pending" language
- Finance to accept net-30 invoices; vendor must reference PO number on invoices
- Vendor must provide broker confirmation email within 2 business days (we need that to allow pilot start)
- Full endorsement must be uploaded to the contract folder within 10 business days of PO issuance; if not received, we will pause further invoicing and revert to hold until endorsement is in place

Marissa — can you flag legal if we should tighten the conditional language further? My read: amounts under $250k are eligible for conditional activation with the controls above. If legal wants a specific fallback clause we can add it to the PO.

Avery — please confirm with Lina that the timeline above works and capture Marco Diaz on any broker calls so we can coordinate exact endorsement text.

Ben Carter
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
